basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at the HKUST NLP Group. Research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning, with particular interests in LLM Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning, hallucination in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and LLM truthfulness and interpretability.

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
